headline_marked: [[Tarique Rahman heads to Feni]] for day-long tour, inaugurating projects and distributing cards
headline: Tarique Rahman heads to Feni for day-long tour, inaugurating projects and distributing cards
summary: He will inaugurate flood control projects, distribute family and farmer cards, and participate in tree planting in Parshuram and Fulgazi upazilas. The visit also includes the launch of rooftop solar power supply to the national grid.
details: BNP Acting Chairman Tarique Rahman departed from his Gulshan residence in Dhaka this morning, Thursday, at approximately 8:30 AM, embarking on a road journey to Feni. His day-long tour includes inaugurating various projects and participating in multiple programs in the district.

During his visit, Rahman is scheduled to inaugurate flood control projects, participate in tree planting, launch rooftop solar power supply to the national grid, and distribute family and farmer cards in Parshuram and Fulgazi upazilas.

Feni holds personal significance for Tarique Rahman, as it is the ancestral district of his maternal grandfather, Iskandar Majumder, from Fulgazi upazila. His mother, former Prime Minister Khaleda Zia, was elected Member of Parliament five times from the Feni-1 constituency, which includes Fulgazi and two other upazilas.
Following the completion of his scheduled engagements in Feni, the BNP Acting Chairman is expected to return to Dhaka later this evening.
caption:

headline_marked: [[Passengers foil co-pilot's bid to crash Dubai-Tel Aviv flight]], Israel vows probe
headline: Passengers foil co-pilot's bid to crash Dubai-Tel Aviv flight, Israel vows probe
summary: Passengers on a flydubai flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv reportedly intervened to prevent a co-pilot from crashing the plane. Israeli PM Netanyahu confirmed the foiled attempt and stated Israel's intent to investigate.
details: Passengers aboard a flydubai flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv reportedly intervened to prevent a co-pilot from crashing the aircraft. The dramatic incident unfolded mid-air, averting a potential disaster.
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu confirmed the foiled attempt on Wednesday. He stated that Israel would get to the 'root' of the co-pilot's actions.
Netanyahu also indicated that Israel would 'possibly' be participating in the probe into the incident. The investigation aims to understand the full circumstances behind the co-pilot's actions.
caption:
A flydubai flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv faced a mid-air crisis when a co-pilot reportedly attempted to crash the plane. Passengers intervened, averting a potential disaster.

Passengers aboard a flydubai flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv reportedly intervened to prevent a co-pilot from crashing the aircraft. The dramatic incident unfolded mid-air, averting a potential disaster.

Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu confirmed the foiled attempt on Wednesday. He stated that Israel would get to the 'root' of the co-pilot's actions.

Netanyahu also indicated that Israel would 'possibly' be participating in the probe into the incident. The investigation aims to understand the full circumstances behind the co-pilot's actions.
